subject: CS352
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is comprehensive, featuring highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is strong for core software engineering topics like SDLC and Agile, but lacks a suitable video for the more business-oriented 'Systems Acquisition' topic, as no candidates passed the relevance and language gates. For 'Enterprise Architecture', an excellent video on the related concept of organizational structure was chosen.
